info.name: SaaS ERP Backend API
info.description:
Full NestJS backend collection.

1. Set `baseUrl` (default http://127.0.0.1:3000)
2. Run **Auth → POST /auth/login** (saves accessToken)
3. Set `companyId` (seed demo: 019f989b-6d98-7429-80ae-32d0c1cbf7f9)
4. Replace other `{{...Id}}` vars as you create records.

Demo login: admin@saas-erp.local / Admin123!
